nonGoals: Production deployment or promotion, paid service upgrade, DNS changes, schema/data migration or real external business action.

stopConditions: This candidate lacks maintainer-approved factory contract: stop before implementation or merge.

Reproducible local tests, linked hosted CI results on exact head, scoped change list and distinct independent review verdict.

responsibilities: Deliver only the assigned PEX platform, AI, administration, or release-evidence outcome within existing service boundaries.
authority: Read Painter OS source and edit only this contract’s owned paths after base-owned contract approval and dependency clearance.
prohibitedActions: No production promotion or changes to production state, secrets, billing, DNS, providers, schemas, customer data, or live payments without explicit owner authorization.
No work, synchronization, issue mutation, or task dispatch in the separate mplsjohnnycage/factory project.

integrationConstraints: The platform-admin route delegates to @painter-os-bts/platform/components/platform-app; the real UI integration surface is packages/platform-admin-ui plus apps/platform-admin/src/app/platform/[[...section]]/page.tsx.
Keep the dashboard read-only; unknown, missing, stale, or unverified status must never be rendered as healthy/green. Do not introduce a second status authority.
